name: Can I install aging-in-place flooring over existing subflooring?

mainEntity.name: Can I install aging-in-place flooring over existing subflooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many cases, aging-in-place friendly flooring can be installed over existing subflooring, but proper preparation is crucial. The subfloor must be clean, dry, level, and structurally sound to ensure a successful and safe installation. Any existing imperfections like unevenness, cracks, or loose boards must be repaired or addressed prior to installation. Some materials, like luxury vinyl plank, are more forgiving of minor subfloor issues, while others, such as tile, require a very flat and stable surface. An assessment by a qualified contractor will determine the necessary preparation steps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, if the existing subfloor is clean, dry, level, and sound. Proper preparation, including repairs for imperfections, is essential for a safe installation.
